summary: Broad pass over the diff; one likely off-by-one and one speculative nil-dereference.

findings.title: Off-by-one in page boundary check
findings.description: The loop condition uses <= against the page size, which includes one element past the intended boundary.
findings.uncertainty: Have not confirmed pageSize's exact semantics against callers.

findings.title: Possible nil dereference on empty config
findings.description: cfg.Retry is dereferenced without a nil check after LoadConfig, which can plausibly return a zero-value Config.
findings.uncertainty: Have not traced whether LoadConfig can actually return a nil Retry field.
